@.agents/memories/20-tooling.md

- `.rulesync/` is the source of truth. Author changes in `rules`, `skills`, `subagents`, `commands`, `hooks`, and `mcp` there first.
- Generated target directories and prompt files are build artifacts. Regenerate them from RuleSync instead of editing them by hand.
- Keep the shared root `AGENTS.md` content in this overview rule and keep follow-up split rules off AGENTS-writing targets so regeneration stays stable.
- When generated output looks wrong, fix `.rulesync/` and re-run `rulesync`.
- Keep frontmatter strictly RuleSync-compliant; target-specific blocks only for real runtime differences.
- Keep commands deterministic and hooks advisory/portable.
- Validate and regenerate with the system-wide `rulesync` binary: use `rulesync generate --check` as the consistency gate, then `rulesync generate` when changes are intentional.
- Review source and generated diffs together; do not hand-edit generated target directories to patch a platform quirk.
- **Verify target configurations** using the per-target checklists in `.rulesync/verification/` before committing changes.
- Use RuleSync commands directly instead of manually reproducing catalog, prompt, incident, or graph logic from source.
- If RuleSync reports `Multiple root rulesync rules found`, ensure only one root overview rule exists in
- Tab cycles **primary** agents only; `<REDACTED_USER>` invokes subagents.
